verdict.rationale: Snowflake exposes SQL, a documented CLI that can run headlessly/keylessly (confirmed by runtime probe), and an official MCP server for agent access, giving AI-native users multiple documented programmatic entry points. However, no first-party REST/OpenAPI spec was found (openapi.json probes all 404), so a fully documented general-purpose public API is not clearly evidenced beyond CLI/SQL/MCP surfaces. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST API spec, independent hands-on confirmation of full API coverage beyond CLI/MCP, and clearer documentation of REST endpoints for non-SQL operations.
